import sys
from awsglue.utils import getResolvedOptions
from pyspark.context import SparkContext
from awsglue.context import GlueContext
from awsglue.job import Job
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.ml.feature import StringIndexer

args = getResolvedOptions(sys.argv, ["JOB_NAME"])

sc = SparkContext()
glueContext = GlueContext(sc)
spark = glueContext.spark_session
job = Job(glueContext)
job.init(args["JOB_NAME"], args)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Configuration
# --------------------------------------------------
BUCKET = "propelnoi-vijay-datalake"

TRAINING_INPUT_PATH = f"s3://{BUCKET}/outputs/output_market_rent_training/"
SCORING_INPUT_PATH = f"s3://{BUCKET}/outputs/output_market_rent_scoring_input/"
INFERENCE_OUTPUT_PATH = f"s3://{BUCKET}/modeling/market_rent/inference_input/"

# --------------------------------------------------
# Read source data
# --------------------------------------------------
print("Reading training and scoring datasets as PARQUET...")
train_raw = spark.read.parquet(TRAINING_INPUT_PATH)
score_raw = spark.read.parquet(SCORING_INPUT_PATH)

print("Training schema:")
train_raw.printSchema()

print("Scoring schema:")
score_raw.printSchema()

# --------------------------------------------------
# Basic cleanup
# --------------------------------------------------
train_raw = (
    train_raw
    .withColumn("city", F.trim(F.col("city")))
    .withColumn("room_type", F.trim(F.col("room_type")))
)

score_raw = (
    score_raw
    .withColumn("city", F.trim(F.col("city")))
    .withColumn("room_type", F.trim(F.col("room_type")))
)

required_train_cols = ["city", "room_type"]
required_score_cols = [
    "property_id",
    "month",
    "city",
    "property_type",
    "units",
    "current_portfolio_rent",
    "room_type",
    "minimum_nights",
    "availability_365",
    "number_of_reviews",
    "review_scores_rating",
    "latitude",
    "longitude"
]

missing_train = [c for c in required_train_cols if c not in train_raw.columns]
missing_score = [c for c in required_score_cols if c not in score_raw.columns]

if missing_train:
    raise Exception(f"Missing training columns: {missing_train}")

if missing_score:
    raise Exception(f"Missing scoring columns: {missing_score}")

# --------------------------------------------------
# Fit same indexers on training data
# --------------------------------------------------
print("Fitting StringIndexer models on training data...")

city_indexer = StringIndexer(
    inputCol="city",
    outputCol="city_idx",
    handleInvalid="keep"
)

room_type_indexer = StringIndexer(
    inputCol="room_type",
    outputCol="room_type_idx",
    handleInvalid="keep"
)

city_model = city_indexer.fit(train_raw)
room_type_model = room_type_indexer.fit(train_raw)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Transform scoring data
# --------------------------------------------------
print("Applying city indexer...")
score_city = city_model.transform(score_raw)
print("Columns after city transform:", score_city.columns)

print("Applying room_type indexer...")
score_indexed = room_type_model.transform(score_city)
print("Columns after room_type transform:", score_indexed.columns)

if "city_idx" not in score_indexed.columns:
    raise Exception("city_idx was not created after transform")

if "room_type_idx" not in score_indexed.columns:
    raise Exception("room_type_idx was not created after transform")

# --------------------------------------------------
# Final inference dataset
# Includes metadata + features for notebook scoring
# --------------------------------------------------
final_df = score_indexed.select(
    F.col("property_id"),
    F.col("month"),
    F.col("city"),
    F.col("property_type"),
    F.col("units").cast("double").alias("units"),
    F.col("current_portfolio_rent").cast("double").alias("current_portfolio_rent"),
    F.lit(3.0).cast("double").alias("inflation_rate"),
    F.col("city_idx").cast("double").alias("city_idx"),
    F.col("room_type_idx").cast("double").alias("room_type_idx"),
    F.coalesce(F.col("minimum_nights"), F.lit(0.0)).cast("double").alias("minimum_nights"),
    F.coalesce(F.col("availability_365"), F.lit(0.0)).cast("double").alias("availability_365"),
    F.coalesce(F.col("number_of_reviews"), F.lit(0.0)).cast("double").alias("number_of_reviews"),
    F.coalesce(F.col("review_scores_rating"), F.lit(0.0)).cast("double").alias("review_scores_rating"),
    F.coalesce(F.col("latitude"), F.lit(0.0)).cast("double").alias("latitude"),
    F.coalesce(F.col("longitude"), F.lit(0.0)).cast("double").alias("longitude")
)

print("Final inference schema:")
final_df.printSchema()

final_df.show(5, truncate=False)
print("Inference row count:", final_df.count())

# --------------------------------------------------
# Write inference CSV for notebook scoring
# WITH header
# --------------------------------------------------
print("Writing inference input CSV...")
final_df.coalesce(1).write.mode("overwrite").option("header", "true").csv(INFERENCE_OUTPUT_PATH)

print("Glue inference export completed successfully.")
job.commit()
